title: Plot Culmination and the Short Story Essay
goal: Analyse thematic convergence with terminar por / acabar por + infinitive (contrasted with terminar de) and read an essay on the short story genre.
grammar: terminar por / acabar por + infinitive with abstract literary subjects vs terminar de + infinitive

items: I can use terminar por / acabar por + infinitive with abstract literary subjects to describe thematic convergence.
I can distinguish terminar por + infinitive ('end up') from terminar de + infinitive ('finish').
I can follow a literary essay on the short story genre analysing ellipsis, voice, symbols, and understated endings.
